dict.string: oldTunes asks Music to save tag changes to songs in your Music library, to add songs to Music when you turn on “Also add to the Music app”, to make, rename and delete the playlists you change in oldTunes and add or remove songs in them, and to download iCloud songs to this Mac.
oldTunes reads your music library so it can list, search and play your songs, including the ones stored in iCloud.
Only oldTunes's own test builds use this, to measure the sound of the songs they play. The oldTunes you download never asks for it.
